item.title: FBI used iPhone notification data to retrieve deleted Signal messages
item.description:
📝 AAPL Company FBI Signal FBI used iPhone notification data to retrieve deleted Signal messages Marcus Mendes | Apr 9 2026 - 4:42 pm PT 12 Comments A new report from 404 Media reveals that the FBI was able to recover deleted Signal messages from an iPhone by extracting data stored in the device’s notification database. social View on Mastodon Back to the case, given Exhibit 158’s description that the messages “were recovered from Sharp’s phone through Apple’s internal notification storage,” it is possible the FBI extracted the information from a device backup. In that case, there are many commercially available tools for law enforcement that exploit iOS vulnerabilities to extract data that could have helped the FBI access this information.

item.title: White House staff told not to place bets on prediction markets
item.description:
📝 It referred to press reports that raised concerns over government officials using non-public information to place bets on platforms like Kalshi or Polymarket. In March, Democrat leaders introduced legislation, external that would completely ban prediction market betting related to war or military action.
